description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows the full product list, containing <at least one product whose name contains a distinctive term> and <at least two products whose names do not contain that term>.
steps: Note the full list of product names shown.
Enter <the distinctive term from a product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names contain the search term are listed; the non-matching products are not listed.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows the full product list.
steps: Enter <a term that appears in no product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is shown (exact text not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows the full product list; <a product whose name contains both upper- and lower-case letters> exists.
steps: Search for <part of that product's name, typed in all lower case> and note the results.
Search for <the same text typed in all UPPER case>.
cases.expected: Both searches list the same matching products, including the product above.

cases.title: Partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows the full product list; <a product whose name is long enough to search by a fragment> exists.
steps: Enter <a fragment from the middle of that product's name, not the whole name> in the search field.
cases.expected: The product is listed; only products whose names contain that fragment are listed.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: Product list page is open and shows the full product list of <a catalogue with several products>.
steps: Note the full list of product names shown.
Search for <a term matching some but not all products> and confirm the list is filtered.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the list noted before the search.
